system.description: The character's vitae carries a lessened Curse of Malkav. Ghouls she creates never gain derangements from drinking her blood, no matter how much they're fed, though any childe she Embraces still gains a derangement as usual — the Curse survives dilution in the Embrace even when it doesn't in ghouled mortal blood.
system.source: Clanbook: Malkavian, New Merits and Flaws
